# NoirMD — Documentation

> NoirMD is a **framework-agnostic markdown renderer**: one vanilla DOM rendering engine with thin React/Vue wrappers. It ships a custom parser, a 26+ directive system (admonitions, cards, modals, details, buttons, slides, interactive components), rich inline syntax, built-in syntax highlighting (highlight.js) and modular pure CSS theming. This file indexes the official documentation. All links are relative to the site root.

## What is NoirMD?

NoirMD transforms Markdown into a typed AST and renders it with a single vanilla DOM engine (`renderMarkdownString(markdown) → HTMLElement`). React and Vue bindings are thin mount-point wrappers around that engine, so behavior is identical across frameworks.

Pipeline: `parseMarkdown(markdown)` → typed `Token[]` AST → vanilla DOM renderer → `HTMLElement` appended by the framework wrapper.

- **Framework-agnostic**: one engine for React, Vue, vanilla JS or any framework
- **Custom parser**: line-by-line state machine producing a typed `Token[]` AST
- **Directive system**: 26+ directive types — admonitions, cards (static/modal/link), modals, details, buttons, slides, accordion, carousel, countdown, diff, chat, richlist, stat, hover effects, keyboard keys
- **Modular CSS**: pure CSS split into `variables.css`, `base.css` and one file per component; `--nr-*` design tokens with `--color-*` host-variable theming
- **Rich inline syntax**: bold, italic, highlight, color, spoiler, underline, icons, centered/right-aligned text and more
- **Syntax highlighting**: code blocks with highlight.js built-in
- **Optional editor**: CodeMirror 6 powered markdown editor with live preview

## Installation

```bash
# Core + React
npm install @noirmd/previewer react react-dom

# Core + Vue 3
npm install @noirmd/previewer vue

# Core only (Vanilla JS)
npm install @noirmd/previewer
```

Optional editor dependencies:

```bash
npm install @uiw/react-codemirror @codemirror/view @codemirror/state @codemirror/language @lezer/highlight
```

## Package Entry Points

| Import path | Description | Dependencies |
|-------------|-------------|--------------|
| `@noirmd/previewer/core` | Parser, types, utilities | None |
| `@noirmd/previewer/vanilla` | Vanilla DOM renderer — the single rendering engine | None (highlight.js bundled) |
| `@noirmd/previewer/react` | Thin React mount-point wrapper | React ≥18 |
| `@noirmd/previewer/vue` | Thin Vue mount-point wrapper | Vue ≥3 |
| `@noirmd/previewer` | Backward-compatible (core + react) | React ≥18 |
| `@noirmd/previewer/editor` | CodeMirror 6 editor | React + CodeMirror |
| `@noirmd/previewer/editor.css` | Self-contained editor styles (toolbar, layout) | — |
| `@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css` | Full CSS entry (`@import`s all partials) | — |

## Configuration

- **CSS is required.** Import `@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css` once at the top level of your app. Without it, content renders but has no visual styling (no heading sizes, no table borders, no code block backgrounds).
- The CSS is modular: `variables.css` (design tokens), `base.css` (global/reusable styles) and one file per component. Importing `vanilla.css` pulls in everything via `@import`.
- **Theming**: CSS custom properties (`--nr-*`) with `--color-*` host-variable fallbacks (`--color-background-primary`, `--color-text-primary`, `--color-accent-primary`, ...).
- **Tailwind**: works alongside NoirMD — its class names don't conflict. The `tailwindCDN` prop is only needed for Tailwind classes authored inside markdown content; `scanTailwindCDN()` must be called after DOM mutations that add new Tailwind classes.
- **SSR caveat**: React/Vue wrappers render on the client only (`useEffect`/`onMounted`) — server render is an empty placeholder.
- **Editor styles**: `@noirmd/previewer/editor.css` is self-contained and uses `var(--color-*, fallback)` so the host theme wins when defined.
- **Gotchas**: unclosed directives (`:::type` without closing `:::`) render as plain text; `<style>` blocks inject globally into `<head>`; directives have their own padding/borders — avoid nesting them inside flex/grid containers; consecutive `card`/`card-m`/`card-b` auto-batch into a flex-wrap row, consecutive `stat` auto-batch into a grid (use `batch="off"` to disable).

## Quick Usage

### React

```tsx
import { NRpreviewer } from '@noirmd/previewer/react';
import '@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css';

function App() {
  return <NRpreviewer content="# Hello **world**" tailwindCDN />;
}
```

### Vue 3

```vue
<script setup>
import { NRpreviewer } from '@noirmd/previewer/vue';
import '@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css';

const markdown = '# Hello **world**';
</script>

<template>
  <NRpreviewer :content="markdown" />
</template>
```

### Vanilla JS

```ts
import { renderMarkdownString } from '@noirmd/previewer/vanilla';
import '@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css';

const el = renderMarkdownString('# Hello **world**');
document.getElementById('app')!.appendChild(el);
```

## Directive System

All directives use the `:::type {props} ... :::` syntax. Props support `key="value"` pairs, `.className` shorthand, and `#id` shorthand. Short-form title: `:::note My Title` is equivalent to `:::note {title="My Title"}`. Content is split into slots via `#slotname` lines at depth 0.

### Admonitions

| Directive | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `:::note` | Neutral info box |
| `:::info` | Informational (lightbulb icon) |
| `:::warning` | Amber caution box |
| `:::danger` | Red error/critical box |
| `:::greentext` | Green forum-style quote |

Props: `title`, `icon`, `class`, `style`. Content supports full markdown.

### Cards

| Directive | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `:::card` | Static card with icon, title and markdown content |
| `:::card-m` | Interactive card — click opens a modal with `#content` slot |
| `:::card-b` | Interactive card — click navigates to `url` prop |

Props: `title`, `icon`, `image`, `url` (card-b required), `target`, `batch`, `class`, `style`. Slots: `default`, `#description`, `#content` (card-m only). Consecutive cards auto-batch into a flex-wrap grid (`batch="off"` to disable).

### Interactive

| Directive | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `:::details` | Collapsible `<details>` section |
| `:::modal` | Native `<dialog>` modal with trigger button |
| `:::button` | Styled link/button with icon |
| `:::slide` | Auto-advancing text carousel (sections split by `---`) |

### Components

| Directive | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `:::keys` | Keyboard key display — auto-splits by `+`. Prop: `size` (xs/sm/md/lg/xl) |
| `:::accordion` | Collapsible accordion container. Prop: `mode` (radio/checkbox). Contains `:::accordion-item` children with `title` and optional `checked` |
| `:::carousel` | Image carousel with arrows, dots and infinite loop. Props: `height`, `aspect`, `width`, `float`. Content: markdown images |
| `:::countdown` | Countdown timer — static (`days`/`hours`/`min`/`sec`) or live (`target` ISO date). Props: `labels`, `digits` |
| `:::diff` | Before/after image comparison slider. Props: `before`/`after` URLs or two markdown images. Also: `height`, `aspect`, `width`, `float` |
| `:::hover-3d` | 3D tilt card that follows mouse cursor. Content: HTML or markdown |
| `:::hover-gallery` | Grid gallery — images expand on hover. Prop: `aspect` |
| `:::chat` | Chat bubble container. Contains `:::chat-item` children with `side` (start/end), `name`, `time`, `avatar`, `color`, `footer` |
| `:::richlist` | Rich list with avatars/actions. Contains `:::richlist-item` children with `title`, `subtitle`, `image`, `icon`, `icon2` |
| `:::stat` | Statistic card (icon, value, description). Props: `title`, `value`, `desc`, `icon`, `color`, `batch`. Consecutive stats auto-batch into a grid |

### Layout

`:::div`, `:::style`, `:::raw`, `:::custom` are all generic wrapper directives (identical behavior — render a `<div>` with optional `class`, `id`, `style`, `data-*` attributes). For actual CSS injection, use `<style>` HTML blocks. For raw HTML, write HTML directly in markdown.

## Inline Syntax

NoirMD extends standard markdown with inline formatting:

| Syntax | Result | Notes |
|--------|--------|-------|
| `**text**` | **Bold** | |
| `_text_` | *Italic* | `*text*` does NOT work — use underscores |
| `***text***` | ***Bold+Italic*** | |
| `~~text~~` | ~~Strikethrough~~ | |
| `` `code` `` | `Inline code` | |
| `==text==` | ==Highlight== | |
| `%red%text%%` | Colored text | Closing is `%%`, not `%` |
| `!~underline~!` | !~Underline~! | Extended: `!~color;style;type;text~!` |
| `!>text<!` | Spoiler (hidden) | Hover/tap to reveal |
| `->text<-` | Centered text | Block-level |
| `->text->` | Right-aligned text | Block-level |
| `\|[[icon-name]]\|` | Material icon | Any Material Symbols name |
| `[text](url)` | Link | |
| `![alt](src#float#3d){w:h}` | Image | Float: `#left`/`#right`/`#center`. Size: `{width:height}` |

## Block Syntax

- **Headers**: `#` through `######` with auto-generated anchor IDs
- **Code blocks**: ` ```lang title="name" ``` ` with highlight.js
- **Tables**: pipe-delimited with alignment (`:---`, `:---:`, `---:`)
- **Lists**: `-`, `*`, `+`, `1.` — continuation lines via indentation
- **Blockquotes**: `> text` with `##{.class #id}` attributes
- **Horizontal rules**: `---`, `___`, `***`
- **TOC**: `[TOC]` or `[TOC2]` generates clickable table of contents
- **HTML blocks**: raw HTML rendered directly; `<style>` injects CSS globally; `<script>` executes automatically
- **Attributes**: any block can carry `##{.class #id}` suffix for custom classes/IDs
